_comment: COMPACT-01  A SHORTER BLOCK. dt270 data only, fully reversible. This is the pack for 'I want more compact formations so space is hard to find'. Both fields are STOCK - nobody has ever touched the two fields that actually set how long the team is. lengthOf (basePosition+0x228, stock 35) IS the team's front-to-back length in metres. Verified on the INSTALLED image this session: the defensive-line builder 0x143dea9f0 loads it at 0x143deaa33, caps it at 33 in one shape mode (0x143deaa80), and on the kickoff path at 0x143deaac0..0x143deaad8 literally computes forwardLineX = kickoffDfLineX + lengthOf = -18 + 35 = +17 and writes the pair into the line-target array the midfield builder reads back. In open play (0x143deaf5e..0x143deaf83) it builds a band of 0.5 * lengthOf scaled by dfLineRate. It is also read twice more in 0x143e7f4c0. Every use is linear in the field. 35 -> 29 shortens the block by 6 m, about 17%. adjustXCompactFW (basePosition+0x6c, stock 0.5) drags the forward line back by the line's player count: verified at 0x143de993f..0x143de9969, targetX += -adjustXCompactFW * (n - 1) where n comes from 0x1442dfdc0(ctx, team, kind=3). Today that is a 1.0-1.5 m pull-back for a front two or three; at 1.4 it becomes 2.8-4.2 m, and unlike lengthOf it is player-count aware, so a front three compresses more than a lone striker. TOGETHER: the forward line sits roughly 9-10 m deeper relative to the back line than it does today. Less room between the lines means more bodies in the passing lanes. ON DEFLECTIONS - BE HONEST WITH YOURSELF ABOUT WHAT THIS BUYS. The engine definitely models per-limb ball collision: every player carries a 21-slot collision-part state array at player+0x2f18 with a setter (0x143eb66d0) and getter (0x143eaae10), a per-frame pass (0x143ff2620) writes a physics filter group per limb, dt270's trap.afterCollision.noHit.foot/reg/thigh exist purely to DISABLE specific parts for N frames after a touch (0x143f85b50) - you only suppress a collision that would otherwise happen - and deflection is a first-class outcome (PRE_RESULT_DEFLECTION, match::anime::action::Block, DF_BLOCK, HIT_OBJ, plus a telemetry predicate CheckBallCollisionPart at 0x1449ba410). What is NOT proven is that a pass through a crowd deflects off a player who is making no play at all. Expect MORE BLOCKS AND INTERCEPTIONS from compactness; treat random leg deflections as unproven. Separately: the dt270 'ball' object has 66 fields and not one of them concerns hitting a player, so deflection response is engine-side and cannot be tuned from dt270 at all. WHO: everyone, at every difficulty - one shared basePosition per team, no GetParam call site in the shape code. EVIDENCE: b-disassembly, re-read by me this session at every site named above. Both fields are 'read' in build/dt270_liveness.json. Not emulated end to end - 0x143dea9f0 needs a full team world to drive. VALUES: 29 / 1.4. SOFTER: 32 / 1.0. STRONGER: 27 / 1.8 - do not go below 27; 35 was already a realistic mid-block and the engine's own minWidth floor starts fighting you. WHAT TO WATCH FOR: midfield and attack arriving as one unit rather than strung out; second balls dropping to your own players; noticeably more blocked passes in the middle third. TOO STRONG IF: your forwards camp on the midfield line and you have no outlet on a counter, or long clearances are uncontested because nobody is high enough to chase. Then go back to 32 / 1.0. REVERT: python tools/gameplay_tune.py set basePosition.lengthOf=35 basePosition.adjustXCompactFW=0.5

edits._note: 35 -> 29 (stock 35, never modified). Team front-to-back length in metres. Read at 0x143deaa33, 0x143e8029e, 0x143e80347.
0.5 -> 1.4 (stock 0.5). targetX += -adjustXCompactFW * (n-1) for the forward line. Sole reader 0x143de993f.
